dependencies.integration_publication_freeze: separate owner handoff required; no qualification inferred from working source
dependencies.recovery_adapters: separate creation and validator publication preparation/export/restore owner handoffs

provider_launch.independent_authority: Exact externally approved sha256 profile selects full role roster, operator origin, original domain, client, provider public key, private Directory and persistent SourceGeneration. Retained leaves and current SQL never select authority.
provider_launch.actual_callsite: Standalone provide/auth-provide and swarm enter newProviderDeviceLocal. It verifies the retained seed/client against the selected profile and calls connect.ValidateOriginalContractStore before sdk.NewDeviceLocal.
provider_launch.settings: OriginalContractCaptureSettings.Directory, PublicKey and SourceGeneration are copied from the selected approved owner. SDK request Generation remains the actual fresh manager lifecycle.
provider_launch.mandatory_preparation: Before launch, storage-prepare must explicitly prepare sdk-original-contract-store under the accepted stopped-writer and zero-history fence, using the approved urnetwork-original-contract-preparation-v1 wrapper with capture_profile and slot. Runtime never creates a replacement source birth or restores absent custody.
provider_launch.original_whole_work_profile: unchanged schema and independent request signing authority; whole-work and original contract profiles must agree on original client/key/domain and use disjoint private directories
provider_launch.bootstrap_export: bootstrap-chain provider-role-config accepts original_contract_capture_profile references and require_original_contract_capture; exported argument vectors preserve exact profile path/hash and mandatory flag
provider_launch.legacy: Omitting optional capture configuration preserves providing with unknown original-source coverage. It does not establish empty or complete evidence. Required capture refuses absent profile or unprepared source.
provider_launch.source_generation: Persistent custody namespace only; never a configured substitute for actual SDK lifecycle Generation. Restart retains original files and approved custody scope while producing a fresh SDK generation.

validator_launch.selection: Complete original validator/operator census and each hash-and-byte-pinned RequestPreparation; explicit server_profile is exactly testnet or mainnet and is never inferred from policy or environment.
validator_launch.scope: RequestReceiptScope matches independently admitted original GenesisHash, DeploymentId, PolicyHash, Netuid and NoId; DeploymentKey is decimal nonzero ChainId + colon + lowercase nonzero original Coordinator address, matching Server original st_config construction.
validator_launch.runtime_type: Actual validator.OperatorConfig copied with paired RequestPreparation and RequestReceiptScope, retaining every unrelated original operator setting
validator_launch.publication_profile: Complete canonical validator.ProviderAttemptPublicationPreparation and its sha256 digest come from the same runtime profile computation, including original request births and existing finite evidence bounds.
validator_launch.publication_preparation: Extract the exact canonical PublicationPreparation object and independently approve its digest. The validator-provider-attempt-publications adapter consumes urnetwork-provider-attempt-publication-preparation-v1 with preparation_profile and requires the fixed StateDir/provider-attempt-publications namespace. No runtime auto-birth.
validator_launch.approval_boundary: Output is an unsigned deterministic review/adoption patch, marked requires_owner_signing_and_adoption and requires_stopped_writer_preparation. Original signed ReleaseConfig and approval files are read-only, never modified, re-signed or represented as approving the new fields. Owners must approve and sign/adopt the successor config before production use.

qualification_limits: Thirteen distinct new top-level roots are authored, not executed. Prior miner17/mode and earlier whole-work roots retain their separately recorded scopes.

New real SDK test uses the production constructor, explicit prepared namespace, public DeviceLocal.SendSubprotocolBytes and real local HTTPS /connect/control. It checks that the signed request is already retained before HTTP, both lifecycle joins, fixed original custody and generation-attributed restart observations.

The new SDK test does not claim successful operator admission or an end-to-end successful miner Run. Core creation owner tests and Recovery public preparation/export/restore tests are separate required qualification inputs.

Only source inspection, gofmt and git diff --check were performed by this author. No author compilation, test execution, full copy, live service launch, network submission or authority signing occurred.
